newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Borsodchem to build HUF 1bln plant - MTI.
newsitem.headline: Borsodchem to build HUF 1bln plant - MTI.

text.p: Hungarian chemicals company Borsodchem has applied for environmental approval for a 35,000 to 40,000 tonnes per year formalin plant, Hungarian news agency MTI-Econews said on Friday.
It said the plant would cost one billion forints and Borsodchem is considering to build a synthetic resin plant in order to use the new plant's excess capacity.
Borsodchem buys 13,000 tonnes of formalin a year.
Borsodchem shares put on 300 forints on Friday to close at 5,900.
Company officials were not available for comment.
